scientific_decisions.choice: Original paper section3.2 specifies attention-gated U-Net with pretrained ResNet50; sections3.3/3.5 specify components/crop recognition. Exact architecture/recognizer artifacts remain unresolved.

Qualified warm-start58.155146M two-head decoder, restored original TRAIN image bytes, word-owner/contact guards, kernels and deterministic letterbox transforms; fixed native PARSeq AR/refine1 artifacts.

New low-rank, four-axis, dilated, ownership-supervised dense feature transport at all decoder scales; zero-initialized RGB full-resolution residual. Global averaged-gate control has identical active parameters and ownership loss. Full-resolution targets are computed from original masks/owners, never enlarged native256 targets.

Predeclared six-epoch frozen-source pilot: matched global/local image order, augmentation and update budget; CAL100 selects among epochs0/3/6 and54 common postprocess policies. The source U-Net reference has zero training epochs. TEST300 only after selections sealed. FIT1028 excludes TRAIN81/212 duplicate images, but warm-start source previously saw them and CAL100; historical TEST/CAL exposure prevents fresh generalization claims.

Primary micro word F1: Unicode casefold then isalnum; maximum one-to-one unpadded original bboxIoU>=.5 plus exact normalized text. All care GT/all emitted outputs count, including empty and duplicate strings; no ignore-area neutralization. Separate lexical F1 is secondary. Common minarea4 at native256 scale, cap40, padding0/1 scaled with native resolution, CAL native PARSeq sequence-confidence threshold.

Verified RTX3090, single GPU FP32 without TF32 or AMP; batch4, frozen encoder/statistics, sequential arm execution, recognizer released between validation and training. Record allocated/reserved peaks, input shape, and OOM; never silently reduce batch.

No claim of worldwide novelty. Directional propagation and semantic/shape streams have established precedents (SPN2017/Gated-SCNN2019). New application is an experimental extension, with single-seed optimization/convergence and annotation/crop artifacts as limitations. Strict AG-UNet/PARSeq-S provenance and reproduction blockers remain unchanged.

After completed v1 continuation controls fall below epoch0 on CAL100, freeze every source U-Net weight and all source BatchNorm running statistics. Train only71,590 new transport/RGB-detail parameters. Use an explicit zero-epoch frozen U-Net reference and matched global/local six-epoch budgets with epochs0/3/6 eligible. This tests source drift without adding capacity, new OCR models or TEST-based selection.
Preserve every eligible evaluation-epoch model checkpoint in addition to best/last; this retention change does not alter optimization, inference or the predeclared CAL policy grid.
